metrics.note: Prediction timings exclude capture, image loading, text setup, output files and LLM. The first prediction in a process may include initialization. Benchmark repeats one loaded image.
metrics.tool_timing_note: Total excludes constructing SceneObserver; includes prompt setup, camera process startup/settling, capture, detection and initial output saves. It is not pure sensor latency.

limitations: These are unverified detections from one frame. Counts may include false positives and duplicates; objects may be missed. Zero means not detected, not absent. Confidence scores are not calibrated probabilities. No identity, distance, intent or activity is measured.
